fields.description:
Objective

Give Reps buttons on the Sign-Up record page that drive status progression through guided screen flows instead of raw field edits.

Implementation Requirements

* Log Sign Up / Complete Sign Up screen flow capturing the key Rep-editable fields

* All required fields complete -> Status = Completed

* Requirements not met -> Status = In Progress

* Archive screen flow capturing Archive Reason and Additional Notes; sets Status = Archived

* Flag screen flow capturing Fraud Reason and Additional Notes; sets Status = Flagged

Acceptance Criteria

* A Rep can progress a Sign-Up through every stage using buttons only

* No stage change requires editing the Status field directly

Additional Notes

Field-level content of these flows is revised by BUILD-43 (Doc #29/#42), BUILD-52 (Doc #43) and BUILD-53 (Doc #44).

Verified in sandbox: Complete_Sign_Up, Screen_Sign_Up_Archive, Screen_Sign_Up_In_Progress and Flag_Sign_Up flows plus matching quick actions.

Source: Wagertech Additional User Stories, July 2026 — item 2.
